lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple horizontal rows of high-luminance circular spots organized in a semi-regular grid posterior to the pectoral fin, with highest intensity clusters located mid-flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting horizontal spot rows to form rectangular grid nodes across the lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Prominent longitudinal ridge on the upper flank exhibiting a sharp luminance transition, with highlight on the dorsal aspect and shadow on the ventral aspect.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Moderate density of discrete high-luminance blobs distributed across the lateral face of the first dorsal fin, with larger spots centralized and smaller spots toward the margins.

other_distinctive_markers: Extremely high density of micro-spots localized on the dorsal surface of the pectoral fin, contrasting with the larger spot patterns on the primary flank.
